description: Use this when the user asks about a recall of dog food, cat food, pet treats or other pet food, such as "dog food recall this week". Optionally pass a brand or hazard as query, and set withinDays for recent recalls, such as 7 for this week. Returns matching FDA recall announcements, newest first, with the title, date, summary and FDA link. It only sees the FDA's 20 most recent recall announcements (about three weeks) and says so, so for an older recall point the user to the FDA recalls page.

limit.description: Most recalls to return, newest first (default 5)

query.description: Optional brand or hazard to look for, such as "Purina" or "salmonella"; leave out to list every recent pet food recall

withinDays.description: Only announcements from the last this many days, such as 7 for this week

name: search_pet_food_recalls
title: Search pet food recalls
